title: Mole Current: Rust Core
description: Current deterministic Rust core mapped onto the Melee movement spine. Colors show parity status against the Melee reference while SDL remains a visual/runtime shell.

nodes.label: Wait
nodes.notes: Rust-owned grounded neutral state.

nodes.label: WalkSlow
nodes.notes: Explicit Rust MotionState selected from Melee-style walk-speed bucket facts.

nodes.label: WalkMiddle
nodes.notes: Explicit Rust MotionState selected from Melee-style walk-speed bucket facts.

nodes.label: WalkFast
nodes.notes: Explicit Rust MotionState below dash threshold; analog speed remains profile-driven.

nodes.label: Turn
nodes.notes: Rust has a standing turn state and dash-out tests; exact Melee frame data still needs deeper coverage.

nodes.label: Dash
nodes.notes: Rust owns fresh dash tap facts, initial dash, and dash-dance-style opposite tap behavior.

nodes.label: Squat
nodes.notes: Rust has Squat, but SquatWait and SquatRv are not explicit yet.

nodes.label: GuardOn
nodes.notes: Rust has explicit shield startup; shield hit/setoff and powershield families remain incomplete.

nodes.label: KneeBend
nodes.notes: Rust has Falcon 4f jumpsquat, short-hop release tracking, and profile-owned full/short hop takeoff forces; broader aerial physics remains partial.

nodes.label: Run
nodes.notes: Rust has sustained run and no-interrupt windows; remaining run exits need continued Melee parity review.

nodes.label: RunDirect
nodes.notes: Not currently represented as a separate Rust MotionState.

nodes.label: SquatWait
nodes.notes: Held crouch is still folded into Squat.

nodes.label: Guard
nodes.notes: Steady shield exists with jump, grab, roll, spotdodge, and release paths under Rust tests.

nodes.label: JumpF
nodes.notes: Rust now has explicit forward ground jump state; gravity/arc tuning is still provisional.

nodes.label: JumpB
nodes.notes: Rust now has explicit backward ground jump state; gravity/arc tuning is still provisional.

nodes.label: RunBrake
nodes.notes: Explicit Rust state exists and applies traction; exact Melee brake behavior still needs tuning.

nodes.label: TurnRun
nodes.notes: Rust preserves old-facing behavior while velocity crosses zero; still needs frame-perfect reference checks.

nodes.label: SquatRv
nodes.notes: Crouch release is not an explicit Rust MotionState yet.

nodes.label: GuardOff
nodes.notes: Rust has explicit shield release with action tests; exact Melee timing remains under review.

nodes.label: GuardSetOff
nodes.notes: Shield hitstun/setoff family is not implemented yet.

nodes.label: GuardReflect
nodes.notes: Powershield/reflect common-state family is not implemented yet.

nodes.label: EscapeN
nodes.notes: Rust spotdodge state exists; detailed intangibility/action windows are still coarse.

nodes.label: EscapeF
nodes.notes: Rust forward roll state exists; detailed displacement/windows are still coarse.

nodes.label: EscapeB
nodes.notes: Rust backward roll state exists; detailed displacement/windows are still coarse.

nodes.label: JumpAerialF
nodes.notes: Rust double-jump forward state exists and uses a profile-owned air-jump force; broader aerial physics still needs Falcon parity work.

nodes.label: JumpAerialB
nodes.notes: Rust double-jump backward state exists and uses a profile-owned air-jump force; broader aerial physics still needs Falcon parity work.

nodes.label: Air umbrella
nodes.notes: Rust still uses Air as an umbrella fall/drift state instead of explicit Fall, FallF, and FallB; fast-fall velocity now follows the profile-owned Melee path.

nodes.label: Fall
nodes.notes: Not currently represented separately; folded into Air.

nodes.label: FallF
nodes.notes: Not currently represented separately; folded into Air.

nodes.label: FallB
nodes.notes: Not currently represented separately; folded into Air.

nodes.label: EscapeAir
nodes.notes: Rust has airdodge entry, self-velocity, decay, and FallSpecial/LandingFallSpecial exits.

nodes.label: FallSpecial
nodes.notes: Rust has base special fall; forward/back variants are not explicit.

nodes.label: FallSpecialF
nodes.notes: Not currently represented as a separate Rust MotionState.

nodes.label: FallSpecialB
nodes.notes: Not currently represented as a separate Rust MotionState.

nodes.label: Landing
nodes.notes: Rust has general landing state, but collision and landing-lag details still need parity tuning.

nodes.label: LandingFallSpecial
nodes.notes: Rust has fall-special landing lockout; exact wavedash/waveland feel depends on the next collision/air pass.

nodes.label: ShieldTurn tuning aid
nodes.notes: Intentional non-Melee helper behavior stored on Guard/GuardOn rather than as a Rust MotionState.
